version.changelog: Security section now states that the public-data tools read other people's public content without a connected account (read-only, paid from credit).

llm.summary: This skill clearly describes an Instagram management integration with disclosed OAuth handling, public-data lookups, and user-confirmed write actions.

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a Markdown skill with no bundled executable code; external access is limited to ClawLink, Instagram Graph API, public Instagram data tools, documentation, and image resources described in the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation asks the user to install the ClawLink plugin, allow it in OpenClaw config, and restart the gateway; this is a persistent local configuration change but it is disclosed and purpose-aligned for exposing ClawLink tools.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the agent to discover live ClawLink tools, prefer read operations first, preview writes, and require explicit user confirmation before publishing, commenting, DMing, or destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: ClawLink stores OAuth tokens and uses them for authenticated Instagram requests, and public-data calls consume ClawLink credit; both are disclosed, with write and destructive operations requiring confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill enables high-impact Instagram actions such as publishing posts, sending DMs, moderating comments, and changing messaging settings, but these capabilities match the stated Instagram account-management purpose and are clearly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should be comfortable connecting an Instagram Business or Creator account through ClawLink and allowing the plugin to manage posts, comments, DMs, insights, and messaging settings. Confirm all write actions carefully, especially publishing, DM sending, deleting comments, or changing inbox configuration.
